args.question: Review one latest Fizz ranked win against Akali, distinguish worthwhile deaths, early avoidable death, kill conversions and lead shape.
claims: The Fizz versus Akali game was a win at 6/6/5 with four deaths before 15 and two afterward.
At minute 10.5 Akali killed the player in mid with 608 gold unspent, 383 gold behind, and nothing traded back.
In the minute 10.5 death Akali Q dealt 57% of killing damage, Akali R 24%, and the damage was 81% magic and 15% true.
At minute 3.3 Akali killed the player in enemy top jungle with 529 gold unspent; the team traded back.
The deaths at minutes 8.2, 20.4, and 24.1 were marked worth taking because the team took objectives or won the fight.
At minute 8.3 Fizz solo-killed Akali and the team took dragon and voidgrubs; at minute 13.6 another solo Akali kill led to a tower.
Six of eleven takedowns converted to an objective or tower within a minute, while the player's gold difference changed from -292 at 15 to +1200 at 20.
The player farmed 6.3 CS per minute before 15 and 6.8 after 15; Blackfire Torch completed at 14.2 minutes.

turns.text:
**Keep converting Akali kills into objectives, but cut the early deaths that buy nothing.** This was a win, and four of your six deaths came before minute 15. At minute 10.5, Akali killed you mid with 608 gold unspent; your team got nothing back. Her Q dealt 57% of that death’s damage. When E is unavailable, give up the contested minion rather than take another Q trade, then reset when the wave lets you.

The minute 3.3 trip into enemy top jungle also cost a death with 529 gold unspent. Your team traded back, but you gave Akali a chance to follow you out of lane. Secure the mid wave before entering her side of the map. That gives up a speculative jungle play in exchange for a safer recall and your lane gold.

**Keep the conversion pattern:** your solo kill on Akali at minute 8.3 became dragon and voidgrubs; the solo kill at 13.6 became a tower. Six of your eleven takedowns became an objective or tower within a minute. That is how you turned a 292-gold deficit at minute 15 into a 1200-gold lead at minute 20. I would not count the deaths at 8.2, 20.4, or 24.1 against you: they bought objectives or a won fight.

Next game, make the minute 10.5 decision differently: **Akali Q ready, E down: concede the minion instead of donating another death.**
